entries.message: This update includes align website with v1.2.0 release, complete v1.2.0 release candidate, enforce high severity CodeQL gate, reconcile movie aliases on manual unwatch, improve mobile media controls and refreshes, refine mobile media page controls, and proxy Traks analytics through first-party routes.
entries.author: Lasikiewicz
details: Refresh dashboard, Up Next, dismissed-item, history, and About captures for v1.2.0.
Add the Manual Watch review guide and place it between Sync Activity and Guides.
Verify the prospective website build against the release commit.
Centre the locked login in the viewport and restore bundled TV show metadata for TVDB-routed demo details.
Align the release documentation and focused app captures with the v1.2.0 interface.
Block releases when unresolved high-severity CodeQL findings remain.
Dismissing title-only movie reviews now prevents matching provider aliases from being watched again.
Keep season options inline and remove per-episode option menus on phone layouts
Refresh stale Now Playing data when returning to suspended pages
Align mobile page controls with the shared media action-bar layout and remove redundant Options disclosures.
Move TV show summaries beneath the logo while keeping watch progress in its existing mobile row.
Serve tracker JavaScript and events through first-party website and demo routes.
Remove analytics consent banners while honoring DNT and GPC.
